["Blocked. EO 13094 amends sections 4 and 6 of EO 12938 (nonproliferation emergency, 50 U.S.C. 1701 et seq.); its sanctions rest on the national emergency declared in EO 12938, so a YES claim needs held National Emergencies Act continuation notices for every year through 2026-10-14. The packet cites continuation notices only as FRDOC records for 2015-2025 and as unlocated 'NOTICE:' identities for 2002-2009 (dossier: 'Acting identity absent from census'); notices for 1998-2001 and 2010-2014 are not attached, and the jobs/selden-fr-citers text files named by the FRDOC records are not present in this checkout. In addition, EO 13382 (2005-06-28) amended section 4(a) of EO 12938 'to read as follows', so whether EO 13094's own 1998 text survives needs the section-4(a) before-and-after comparison (EO 14294 is cited in the dossier but its relation to EO 12938 was not read). Missing sources: complete annual NEA continuation notice series 1998-2025 for the EO 12938 emergency with held bytes, and a consolidated text of EO 12938 section 4. Rechecked after jobs/selden-fr-citers was restored: the files for the attached FRDOC notices are now on disk, but the notices for the missing years (EO:13094: 1998-2001, 2010-2014; EO:13304: 2009-2021) are still not evidence records in the packet, so they cannot be cited without a new packet."]
